command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
$main="ce51aa2804902990776071293990dad48a4ed1f1"
$candidate="caa4e950fd9e59ff14ef0c8f36c3d6697f57d2ea"
$branch="work/search-content-regex-20261007"
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
& git fetch origin main $branch --no-tags --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "content regex visual fetch failed"}
if((& git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main).Trim() -ne $main){throw "main moved before content regex visual"}
if((& git rev-parse ("refs/remotes/origin/"+$branch)).Trim() -ne $candidate){throw "content regex visual candidate moved"}
$temp=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("fly-content-regex-visual-"+$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID)
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Recurse -Force}
try{
  & git worktree add --detach $temp $candidate
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "content regex visual worktree add failed"}
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $temp
  & .\build.bat Release
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "content regex visual Release build failed"}

  $evidence=Join-Path $repo "logs\remote-evidence"
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $evidence | Out-Null
  $owned=Join-Path $evidence "search-content-regex-visual-owned"
  $left=Join-Path $owned "Left"
  foreach($p in @($left,(Join-Path $owned "appdata"),(Join-Path $owned "localdata"),(Join-Path $owned "tmp"))){
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $p | Out-Null
  }
  Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $left "readme.txt") -Value "owned visual fixture" -Encoding UTF8
  $script=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "capture-search-content-regex-printwindow.py"
@'
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as c
import ctypes.wintypes as W
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from PIL import Image
from pywinauto import Desktop
import win32con, win32gui, win32ui

exe=Path(sys.argv[1]); left=Path(sys.argv[2]); owned=Path(sys.argv[3])
png=Path(sys.argv[4]); geometry=Path(sys.argv[5])
env={**os.environ,
     "APPDATA":str(owned/"appdata"),
     "LOCALAPPDATA":str(owned/"localdata"),
     "TEMP":str(owned/"tmp"),
     "TMP":str(owned/"tmp")}
u=c.windll.user32
CALL=c.WINFUNCTYPE(W.BOOL,W.HWND,W.LPARAM)
u.EnumWindows.argtypes=[CALL,W.LPARAM]
u.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes=[W.HWND,c.POINTER(W.DWORD)]
u.GetWindowTextW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.LPWSTR,c.c_int]
u.PostMessageW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.UINT,W.WPARAM,W.LPARAM]
u.PrintWindow.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.HDC,W.UINT]
u.PrintWindow.restype=W.BOOL

def ownedwindows(pid):
    found=[]
    @CALL
    def cb(hwnd,_):
        process=W.DWORD()
        u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd,c.byref(process))
        if process.value==pid and u.IsWindowVisible(hwnd):
            title=c.create_unicode_buffer(700)
            u.GetWindowTextW(hwnd,title,len(title))
            found.append((int(hwnd),title.value))
        return 1
    u.EnumWindows(cb,0)
    return found

proc=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),str(left)],cwd=str(exe.parent),env=env,
    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
hwnd=None
try:
    deadline=time.time()+25
    while time.time()<deadline:
        if proc.poll() is not None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"visual app exited early: {proc.returncode}")
        windows=[x for x in ownedwindows(proc.pid) if "flyExplorer" in x[1]]
        if len(windows)==1:
            hwnd=windows[0][0]
            break
        time.sleep(.15)
    if hwnd is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"visual HWND not found: {ownedwindows(proc.pid)!r}")

    win=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=hwnd)
    win.child_window(auto_id="SearchPanelButton").wrapper_object().invoke()
    scope=win.child_window(auto_id="SearchScopeBox")
    deadline=time.time()+8
    while time.time()<deadline and not (scope.exists(timeout=.15) and scope.is_visible()):
        time.sleep(.12)
    if not (scope.exists(timeout=.15) and scope.is_visible()):
        raise RuntimeError("Search panel did not open for visual capture")

    names=[
        "SearchContentBox",
        "SearchContentRegexBox",
        "SearchContentEncodingBox",
        "SearchRunButton",
    ]
    rects={}
    for name in names:
        control=win.child_window(auto_id=name)
        if not control.exists(timeout=3):
            raise RuntimeError(f"missing visual control: {name}")
        r=control.rectangle()
        rects[name]={"left":r.left,"top":r.top,"right":r.right,"bottom":r.bottom}

    row=rects
    if row["SearchContentBox"]["right"] > row["SearchContentRegexBox"]["left"]:
        raise RuntimeError("content box overlaps content regex checkbox")
    if row["SearchContentRegexBox"]["right"] > row["SearchContentEncodingBox"]["left"]:
        raise RuntimeError("content regex checkbox overlaps encoding selector")

    leftw,topw,rightw,bottomw=win32gui.GetWindowRect(hwnd)
    width=rightw-leftw; height=bottomw-topw
    if width<=0 or height<=0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"invalid window rect {(leftw,topw,rightw,bottomw)!r}")

    hwnd_dc=win32gui.GetWindowDC(hwnd)
    src_dc=win32ui.CreateDCFromHandle(hwnd_dc)
    mem_dc=src_dc.CreateCompatibleDC()
    bitmap=win32ui.CreateBitmap()
    bitmap.CreateCompatibleBitmap(src_dc,width,height)
    mem_dc.SelectObject(bitmap)
    bmp=png.with_suffix(".bmp")
    try:
        ok=u.PrintWindow(W.HWND(hwnd),W.HDC(mem_dc.GetSafeHdc()),2)
        if not ok:
            raise RuntimeError("PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) failed")
        bitmap.SaveBitmapFile(mem_dc,str(bmp))
    finally:
        win32gui.DeleteObject(bitmap.GetHandle())
        mem_dc.DeleteDC()
        src_dc.DeleteDC()
        win32gui.ReleaseDC(hwnd,hwnd_dc)

    with Image.open(bmp) as image:
        image.convert("RGB").save(png)
    bmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    geometry.write_text(json.dumps({
        "window":{"left":leftw,"top":topw,"right":rightw,"bottom":bottomw,
                  "width":width,"height":height},
        "controls":rects,
        "candidate":"caa4e950fd9e59ff14ef0c8f36c3d6697f57d2ea",
    },ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"CONTENT_REGEX_PRINTWINDOW_SCREENSHOT={png}",flush=True)
    print(f"CONTENT_REGEX_VISUAL_GEOMETRY={geometry}",flush=True)
    print("CONTENT_REGEX_VISUAL_NON_OVERLAP=PASS",flush=True)
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:
        if hwnd: u.PostMessageW(W.HWND(hwnd),0x10,0,0)
        try: proc.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.kill(); proc.wait(timeout=5)
    print(f"CONTENT_REGEX_VISUAL_PROCESS_EXIT={proc.returncode}",flush=True)
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding UTF8

  $png=Join-Path $evidence "search-content-regex-after.png"
  $geometry=Join-Path $evidence "search-content-regex-after-geometry.json"
  & python -X utf8 $script (Join-Path $temp "out\winui\Release\flyExplorer.exe") $left $owned $png $geometry
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "content regex PrintWindow visual capture failed"}
  if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $png -PathType Leaf)){throw "content regex AFTER PNG missing"}
  Write-Host "CONTENT_REGEX_VISUAL_AFTER=PASS"
}finally{
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
  if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp){& git worktree remove --force $temp}
  & git worktree prune
}
